mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sales_summary( batch_date, product_code, product_name, total_quantity, total_revenue, order_count ) VALUES ( #{batchDate}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{totalQuantity}, #{totalRevenue}, #{orderCount} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_quantity = total_quantity + VALUES(total_quantity), total_revenue = total_revenue + VALUES(total_revenue), order_count = order_count + VALUES(order_count), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
